paper.title_en: Stochastic gravitational-wave background from subsolar neutron stars in collapsar disks
paper.abstract_en: The fragmentation of the neutrino-cooled accretion disks that surround the black holes formed in collapsars has recently been proposed as an astrophysical channel for the production of neutron stars with masses well below the standard core-collapse floor. These disk-born objects merge either with one another or with the central black hole, and the superposition of all such mergers across cosmic history sources a stochastic gravitational-wave background. In this work we compute the energy density of this background for both merger channels, adopting a formation history tied to the observed rate of long gamma-ray bursts. We find that the merger of a subsolar neutron star with the central black hole is the loudest channel, already constrained by current data and within reach of next-generation observatories, while the binary neutron-star channel is at most two orders of magnitude fainter, with its widest binaries remaining accessible to next-generation detectors. Confronting these predictions with the fourth observing run of the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA Collaboration, we derive two upper bounds on the fraction of collapsars whose disks produce such mergers: a robust one from the non-detection of an isotropic background, and a tighter one that could be achieved by a dedicated search for resolvable subsolar events in current data. Gravitational waves from non-axisymmetric deformations of the collapsar disk itself would provide an additional independent signature for the collapsar scenario, enabling cross-correlation studies with future deci-Hz detectors. Overall, the background computed here provides a population-level probe of disk-born subsolar neutron stars, which next-generation detectors could bring firmly into view.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文计算了坍缩星吸积盘中形成的亚太阳质量中子星并合产生的随机引力波背景，直接面向脉冲星计时阵列与下一代引力波探测器的可观测预言，属于引力波背景这一核心议题，理论深度与可检验性较强，摘要清晰完整，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 坍缩星盘中亚太阳质量中子星产生的随机引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 最近有人提出，坍缩星中形成的黑洞周围受中微子冷却的吸积盘发生碎裂，是产生质量远低于标准核心坍缩下限的中子星的一条天体物理通道。这些盘内诞生的天体要么彼此并合，要么与中心黑洞并合，而所有这类并合在宇宙历史中的叠加会作为随机引力波背景的源。在本工作中，我们针对这两种并合通道计算了该背景的能量密度，采用与观测到的长伽马射线暴发生率相联系的形成历史。我们发现，亚太阳质量中子星与中心黑洞的并合是最响亮的通道，它已被当前数据所限制，并处于下一代天文台的探测范围内；而双中子星通道最多暗两个数量级，其中轨道最宽的双星仍可被下一代探测器触及。将这些预言与LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA合作组的第四次观测运行相对照，我们推导出关于坍缩星中其盘产生此类并合的比率的两个上限：一个来自未探测到各向同性背景的稳健上限，以及一个通过在当前数据中对可分辨的亚太阳质量事件进行专门搜寻而可能达到的更严格上限。来自坍缩星盘本身非轴对称形变的引力波将为坍缩星情景提供额外的独立特征信号，使得能够与未来的分赫兹探测器开展互相关研究。总体而言，这里计算的背景为盘内诞生的亚太阳质量中子星提供了群体层面的探针，下一代探测器可能将其清晰地纳入视野。
